pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind cleanup

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
We are updating etcd client version to 3.4.3 in #83987. This PR updates the default etcd server version to 3.4.3.

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
Update default etcd server version to 3.4.3
```

/sig api-machinery
/area etcd
/priority important-soon

Fixes: #82641
pr_comments:
Hi @jingyih. Thanks for your PR.

I'm waiting for a [kubernetes](https://github.com/orgs/kubernetes/people) member to verify that this patch is reasonable to test. If it is, they should reply with `/ok-to-test` on its own line. Until that is done, I will not automatically test new commits in this PR, but the usual testing commands by org members will still work. If you have questions or suggestions related to my behavior, please file an issue against the [kubernetes/test-infra](https://github.com/kubernetes/test-infra/issues/new?title=Prow%20issue:) repository.

/hold
Until 3.4.3 image is pushed.
Until #83987 is merged.
what's the process to get the images pushed?

> what's the process to get the images pushed?

My current understanding of the process:

1. build and push etcd-related images to `gcr.io/k8s-image-staging`

2. test the new images in K8s cluster

3. promote images from staging repo to `gcr.io/google-containers` via registry promoter.
cc @listx for ongoing `gcr.io/google-containers` promotion improvement efforts

The 3.4.3 version of `etcd` and `etcd-empty-dir-cleanup` images are available in `gcr.io/google-containers`.
Can we get an "ok-to-test"?

/test pull-kubernetes-e2e-kind
should end in about 20 minutes (creates a kubeadm / kind cluster using the new etcd).

/lgtm
/approve

Let's merge this asap to have as much soaking time as possible before the release.

issue_context.title: Update to etcd 3.4 in Kubernetes 1.17 release
issue_context.body:
follow the same pattern that we updated to 3.3.15:
- client side changes needs to be vendored in (similar to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81434)
- update default etcd server (similar to https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/82199)
comments: Let's please do this early in the release cycle. And it should not be that difficult ™️, just mechanical changes following the pattern of the 2 PRs above.
@dims +1. Are you planning to work on it? Or I can do it.
random question: how are these things updated? How are PRs such as https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/83209 generated?

@alejandrox1 I am following [Adding or updating a dependency](https://github.com/kubernetes/community/blob/master/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/vendor.md#adding-or-updating-a-dependency) to update etcd.
/assign @jingyih as you mentioned you would like to update etcd server side to 3.4.3.

Sounds good. I will work on updating default etcd server to 3.4.3.

/assign

review_comments: Do we want to change default of 16 to 3.3.17-0?
Yes, I'm in favor of updating to same patch version for all k8s versions using 3.3 in kubeadm.
